explanation.headline: Zoledronic acid is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; current supply at Corvale East covers 11 days and Corvale General covers 31.7 days

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows zoledronic acid is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 36 vials of the 4 mg/100 mL presentation with a daily use of 3.3 vials, providing 11 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 89 vials of the same presentation with a daily use of 2.8 vials, providing 31.7 days on hand.

The ranked purchasing options are Accord Healthcare Inc. first, AuroMedics Pharma LLC second, and Avenacy Inc. third; none are on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could place.
A label for zoledronic acid names Gland Pharma Limited as the manufacturing plant (FEI 3002647489) with a registered plant link and a most recent VAI inspection ending 2024-07-25.
FDA inspection records for that plant show a series of VAI classifications from 2012 through 2024, with the latest known date 2025-01-15.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
